channel.title: PNallDR
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Democrats dismissed Trump's redistricting gamble until it paid off
item.description: President Trump's redistricting push gave Republicans at least 10 additional conservative-leaning House seats before the midterms.

item.title: Report: Soros, SPLC, CAIR Face Trump Admin Tax Scrutiny
item.description: Nonprofits including Soros' Open Society Foundations, the SPLC, and CAIR are reportedly under tax scrutiny from the Trump administration.

item.title: Mail-voting crackdown advances as Trump court win enables federal action
item.description: Gene Hamilton says federal agencies like USPS can now implement Trump's mail-in ballot safeguards following the Supreme Court's decision.

item.title: Hemp Delay Sets Up House GOP Fight
item.description: House Republicans will face a dispute over intoxicating hemp products in the government funding bill when they return next month.
